title: Arthur742Ramos/KuroshSubgroupTheorem
abstract: Formalizes the sharp Schreier index formula for finite-index subgroups of free groups and the Kurosh subgroup theorem for arbitrary subgroups of indexed free products. The Schreier proof realizes a subgroup as the vertex group of a finite action-groupoid covering, while the Kurosh proof constructs the Bass--Serre tree, a locally bijective graph-of-groups cover, and its path-lifting normal form. The Kurosh factor-only statement is a free product of the nontrivial quotient vertex stabilizers and the free group of the quotient graph; each vertex stabilizer is identified with an intersection with a conjugate of an original factor. For finite-index normal subgroups, a companion module proves that every deck transformation of the finite Schreier action is a unique right translation by the quotient group.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
